kebab_example: aliyun ecd get-login-token --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-id f4a0dc8e-1702-4728-9a60-95b27a350000 --api-version 2020-10-02 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLoginToken

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID generated by the client
parameters.help_zh: 客户端生成的唯一ID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The office network ID, which has the same meaning as `OfficeSiteId`. We recommend that you stop using `DirectoryId` and use `OfficeSiteId` instead. You can specify only one of `DirectoryId` and `OfficeSiteId`, not both
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID，与`OfficeSiteId`含义相同。建议停止使用`DirectoryId`，改为使用`OfficeSiteId`。`DirectoryId`和`OfficeSiteId`只能填写一个，不可同时填写
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The office network ID
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en:
The session ID for logon.

If no virtual MFA device is bound or client secondary authentication is not enabled, you do not need to specify `SessionId`.
If a virtual MFA device is bound or client secondary authentication is enabled, you must specify `SessionId` for the authentication stages after `ADPassword`. You can obtain `SessionId` from the response of the convenience account verification (when the `GetLoginToken` request is in the `ADPassword` stage)
parameters.help_zh:
登录的会话ID。

若未绑定虚拟MFA设备或者未开启客户端二次认证，则不需要填写`SessionId`。
若已绑定虚拟MFA设备或者已开启客户端二次认证，则`ADPassword`之后的登录认证阶段需要填写`SessionId`。可从便捷账号验证（即`GetLoginToken`请求处于`ADPassword`阶段）的返回结果中获取`SessionId`
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en:
The current logon authentication stage. The stages are as follows:

`ADPassword`: verifies user information. Specify this value when authenticating with the credentials of a convenience account or an AD account.
`MFABind`: binds a virtual MFA device.
`MFAVerify`: verifies the security code generated by the virtual MFA device.
`TokenVerify`: performs client secondary authentication.
`ChangePassword`: changes the user password.
`KeepAliveVerify`: exchanges a valid KeepAliveToken for a LoginToken
parameters.help_zh:
当前登录认证阶段，依次为：

`ADPassword`：验证用户信息。当使用便捷账号或者AD账号的账密认证时填写此值。
`MFABind`：绑定虚拟MFA设备。
`MFAVerify`：验证虚拟MFA设备生成的安全码。
`TokenVerify`：客户端二次认证。
`ChangePassword`：修改用户密码。
`KeepAliveVerify`:  KeepAliveToken有效时，可用于换取LoginToken
parameters.name: current_stage

parameters.help_en: The username of the convenience user or AD user. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `ADPassword`
parameters.help_zh: 便捷用户或AD用户的用户名。当`CurrentStage`为`ADPassword`时必填
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The password of the convenience user or AD user. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `ADPassword`
parameters.help_zh: 便捷用户或AD用户的密码。当`CurrentStage`为`ADPassword`时必填
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The old password. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `ChangePassword`
parameters.help_zh: 旧密码。当`CurrentStage`为`ChangePassword`时必填
parameters.name: old_password

parameters.help_en: The new password. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `ChangePassword`
parameters.help_zh: 新密码。当`CurrentStage`为`ChangePassword`时必填
parameters.name: new_password

parameters.help_en: The security code generated by the virtual MFA device. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `MFAVerify`
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟MFA设备生成的安全码。当`CurrentStage`为`MFAVerify`时必填
parameters.name: authentication_code

parameters.help_en: The operating system of the device on which the client runs
parameters.help_zh: 运行客户端的设备的操作系统
parameters.name: client_os

parameters.help_en: The client version. If you use the Elastic Desktop Service client, you can view this parameter in the About dialog box on the client logon page
parameters.help_zh: 客户端版本。若使用无影客户端，可在客户端登录界面的关于对话框中查看该参数
parameters.name: client_version

parameters.help_en: If client secondary authentication is enabled in the Elastic Desktop Service console and the current logon user is identified as risky, a secondary authentication verification code is sent to the end user's email address. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `TokenVerify`
parameters.help_zh: 若已在无影云电脑控制台开启客户端二次认证，且识别到当前登录用户有风险时，会发送该二次认证验证码到终端用户邮箱。当`CurrentStage`为`TokenVerify`时必填
parameters.name: token_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to keep the logon session alive
parameters.help_zh: 是否保持登录
parameters.name: keep_alive

parameters.help_en: The token used to keep the logon session alive. After a successful logon with the keep-alive option enabled, the operation returns a `KeepAliveToken`. While the `KeepAliveToken` is valid, you can call the `GetLoginToken` operation with `CurrentStage` set to `KeepAliveVerify` to exchange it for a logon credential (LoginToken). This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `KeepAliveVerify`
parameters.help_zh: 用于保持登录的凭证（Token），在登录成功且用户开启了保持登录选项后，接口会返回`KeepAliveToken`，在`KeepAliveToken`有效期内可以调用`GetLoginToken`接口并将`CurrentStage`设为`KeepAliveVerify`来换取登录凭证（LoginToken）。当`CurrentStage`为`KeepAliveVerify`时，`KeepAliveToken`必填
parameters.name: keep_alive_token

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the client. If you use the Elastic Desktop Service client, you can view this parameter in the About dialog box on the client logon page
parameters.help_zh: 客户端唯一标识。若使用无影客户端，可在客户端登录界面的关于对话框中查看该参数
parameters.name: uuid

Email.description_en:
The email address of the user. This value is returned with the LoginToken after logon.    

For a convenience user, the email address specified when the convenience user was created is returned.
For an AD user, the value is returned in the format of `username@AD domain name`
Email.description_zh:
用户邮箱。在登录后随LoginToken返回。    

如果是便捷用户，返回创建便捷用户时设置的邮箱。
如果是AD用户，返回以下形式：`用户名@AD域名`

EndUserId.description_en: The convenience account username or AD username
EndUserId.description_zh: 便捷账号用户名或AD用户名

Industry.description_en: This is an internal field and is not available for public use
Industry.description_zh: 内部专用字段，不对外开放使用

KeepAliveToken.description_en: The token used to keep the logon session alive. After a successful logon with the keep-alive option enabled, the operation returns a `KeepAliveToken`. If the keep-alive option is not enabled, an empty value is returned
KeepAliveToken.description_zh: 用于保持登录的凭证（Token），在登录成功且用户开启了保持登录选项后，接口会返回`KeepAliveToken`。若未开启保持登录选项，则返回空值

Label.description_en: The property of the convenience user. If the user is an AD user, an empty value is returned
Label.description_zh: 便捷用户属性。如果是AD用户，则返回空值

NextStage.description_en:
The expected next stage. For example, if the administrator has enabled MFA authentication in the Elastic Desktop Service console, after the username and password authentication is passed (the `ADPassword` stage), this parameter returns `MFAVerify`, indicating that MFA authentication is required.

For more information about each authentication stage, see the parameter description of the `CurrentStage` request parameter of this operation
NextStage.description_zh:
预期的下一阶段。例如，若管理员在无影云电脑控制台开启了MFA认证，则当用户名密码认证通过后（即`ADPassword`阶段后），该参数会返回`MFAVerify`，表示此时需要做MFA认证。

关于各认证阶段的详细信息，参见本接口请求参数`CurrentStage`的参数说明
